commands.name: cells
commands.description: Read, edit, convert and render workbooks through the Aspose.Cells object model.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert a workbook, or CSV or TSV text, to another format with the engine's options for it. An html, mhtml or md output is one file: it holds its images itself (SaveAsSingleFile, ExportImagesAsBase64).

options.name: --bom
options.description: Start a csv or tsv output with a UTF-8 byte order mark, so Excel reads its non-English text correctly. Default: UTF-8 without one.

options.name: --convert-dates
options.description: true or false: whether a .csv, .tsv or .txt input's dates become dates (TxtLoadOptions.ConvertDateTimeData). Required for such an input.

options.name: --convert-numbers
options.description: true or false: whether a .csv, .tsv or .txt input's numbers become numbers (TxtLoadOptions.ConvertNumericData). Required for such an input.

options.name: --culture
options.description: The culture a text input's numbers and dates are read in, such as en-US or de-DE (LoadOptions.CultureInfo). Required when --convert-numbers or --convert-dates is true.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --encoding
options.description: The text encoding of a .csv, .tsv or .txt input, such as utf-8, gb18030 or windows-1252 (TxtLoadOptions.Encoding). Required for such an input.

options.name: --encrypt
options.description: Password for the output workbook. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --encrypt-env.

options.name: --encrypt-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the output workbook.

options.name: --encrypt-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the output workbook from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --format-strategy
options.description: How a csv, tsv or md output writes cell values, a member name of the engine's CellValueFormatStrategy: None writes the values as they are stored, DisplayString as the number formats show them. Default: the engine's.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path. Default: the input path with the target extension (with '.out' inserted when that would overwrite the input).

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the workbook. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the workbook.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the workbook from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --separator
options.description: The separator of a .csv or .txt input, one character (TxtLoadOptions.Separator). Required for such an input; a .tsv input is tab-separated.

options.name: --sheet
options.description: A sheet to write, by its name: one for a csv, tsv or md output, which otherwise holds the sheet the engine writes, the active sheet; any for pdf, repeated. Other formats write the whole workbook.

options.name: --to
options.description: Target format: xlsx, xltx, xlsm, xltm, xlam, xlsb, xls, xlt, csv, tsv, ods, html, mhtml, pdf, xps, json, md. Default: the --out extension's format.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a workbook: the engine's new workbook, or a copy of a template saved in the output's format.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --encrypt
options.description: Password for the output workbook. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --encrypt-env.

options.name: --encrypt-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the output workbook.

options.name: --encrypt-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the output workbook from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --template
options.description: A workbook to save as the new one. Default: the engine's new workbook, with one sheet.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path of the workbook to create, e.g. report.xlsx.

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Apply a batch of set, add, delete, move and do operations to a workbook; nothing is written when one fails.

options.name: --encrypt
options.description: Password for the output workbook. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --encrypt-env.

options.name: --encrypt-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the output workbook.

options.name: --encrypt-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the output workbook from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Modify the input file itself atomically.

options.name: --ops
options.description: The operation document, {"ops": [...]}: a path to it, '-' to read it from stdin, or the document itself when the value starts with { (inline). At most 10000 operations; each is a set, add, delete, move or do. The kinds, rows, adds and actions: aspose-cli schema v2/cells/ops --operation directory; one of them in full: aspose-cli schema v2/cells/ops --operation <name>.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path. Default: the input path with '.out' inserted before the extension.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the workbook. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the workbook.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the workbook from the first line of stdin.

commands.name: read
commands.description: Read a workbook's objects, each with every row of the object table, and its inventory.

options.name: --at
options.description: The address of the object to read with everything below it, as read gives it in at. Default: the whole document.

options.name: --from
options.description: The address of the object the window starts at; a truncated read's window.next gives it.

options.name: --kind
options.description: List only objects of this kind, one the ops schema lists; repeat for several. Default: every kind. Objects of the kinds row, column, cell, style, point are listed only when --kind names them; window.notListedUnlessNamed names those a read left out.

options.name: --max-objects
options.description: The most objects one window lists. Range: 1-10000.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the workbook. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the workbook.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the workbook from the first line of stdin.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render sheets, or an area of one, to images as the engine draws them.

options.name: --area
options.description: An area of the one sheet named, such as A1:G20, set as its print area and drawn alone. Default: the whole sheet.

options.name: --dpi
options.description: Raster resolution; refused for vector output such as svg. Range: 36-1200.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path. Default: the input path with the image extension. Several sheets write <stem>.<sheet>.<ext> beside it.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the workbook. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the workbook.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the workbook from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --sheet
options.description: A sheet to render, by its name; repeat for several. Default: every sheet of the workbook. Several sheets are each written to <stem>.<sheet>.<ext>.

options.name: --to
options.description: Image format. Default: the --out extension's format, else png.

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search the text of a workbook's cells, as their number formats show it, their formulas and their comments; each hit names the object's address and row.

options.name: --case-sensitive
options.description: Match letter case exactly.

options.name: --max-hits
options.description: Maximum returned hits. Range: 1-10000.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the workbook. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the workbook.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the workbook from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Text to find, or a regular expression with --regex.

options.name: --regex
options.description: Treat the pattern as a culture-invariant regular expression with a one-second budget.

options.name: --skip
options.description: Matches to pass over before the returned hits; a truncated search's window.next sets it.

v2/cells/convert-result.description: Result of cells convert: the file a workbook, or CSV or TSV text, was converted to.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: The written files: the one file the input was converted to.

sheets.description: The sheets written, as --sheet named them; omitted when it named none.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Cells reported while it loaded the input and wrote the output, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

cellsConvertOutput.description: The file a workbook was converted to.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

v2/cells/create-result.description: Result of cells create: the new workbook and the template it was saved from, if any.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

inputs.description: The template the workbook was saved from; empty for the engine's new workbook.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Cells reported while it loaded the template and saved the workbook, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

v2/cells/edit-result.description: Result of cells edit: what each operation left, read from the saved workbook after it was opened again, and the inventory counts that changed.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

counts.description: The inventory counts that changed, each as [before, after]; the keys are those read reports in inventory.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Cells reported while it loaded, saved and reopened the workbook, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

ops.description: What each operation left, in batch order: the object at its address in the saved file, or what its action returned; last, since it grows with the batch.

v2/cells/ops.title: Object table operations
v2/cells/ops.description: An edit's operations, applied in order to the document in memory; when one fails, nothing is written. Each kind's definition lists its addresses and rows, each add's and action's the engine call it makes.

address.description: An object's address: 'workbook' for the document itself, otherwise segments and keys from the document down, such as each kind's x-addresses shows. read gives every object's address.

set.description: Sets rows of the object at an address, in the order written; each row sets one engine member.
The address of the object whose rows are set.

props.description: The rows to set, by name, each in its kind's form; the definition of the addressed object's kind lists its rows.

add.description: Makes one engine call that creates an object, then sets rows of the new object.

delete.description: Deletes the object at an address.
The address of the object to delete.

move.description: Moves the object at an address to a position among its siblings.
The address of the object to move.

to.description: The position to move to, the engine's, from 0.

do.description: Makes one engine call on the whole document.

defaultStyle.font.name.description: Workbook.DefaultStyle.Font.Name; set on the DefaultStyle, which is then set back.

defaultStyle.font.doubleSize.description: Workbook.DefaultStyle.Font.DoubleSize, in points; set on the DefaultStyle, which is then set back.

settings.protectionType.description: Workbook.Settings.ProtectionType; the protect_workbook and unprotect_workbook actions change it.

sheet.description: A worksheet or chart sheet of the workbook.

index.description: Worksheet.Index: the sheet's position, from 0; move changes it.

tabColor.description: Worksheet.TabColor; null sets Color.Empty, no tab color.

isProtected.description: Worksheet.IsProtected; the protect_sheet and unprotect_sheet actions change it.

autoFilter.range.description: Worksheet.AutoFilter.Range, an area such as A1:F20; null without an AutoFilter.

freezedPanes.description: Worksheet.GetFreezedPanes(out row, out column, out freezedRows, out freezedColumns), the cell as A1 writes it; null when the panes are not frozen; the freeze_panes and unfreeze_panes actions change it.

maxDisplayRange.description: Worksheet.Cells.MaxDisplayRange.Address: the area that holds the sheet's data, merged cells and shapes, which --at <sheet>/range/<area> reads; null for an empty sheet.

cell.description: A cell of a worksheet. Every cell the sheet's grid has can be addressed; read lists the cells the engine holds.

value.description: Cell.Value, a date as Cell.DoubleValue; set with Cell.PutValue of the value's type.

formula.description: Cell.Formula: null in a cell without one; a formula set is not calculated until the calculate action.

stringValue.description: Cell.StringValue: the value as the cell's number format shows it.

isDynamicArrayFormula.description: Cell.IsDynamicArrayFormula; the set_dynamic_array_formula action sets one.

style.description: A cell's style: each row is one member of Cell.GetStyle(), set alone with Cell.SetStyle(style).

font.doubleSize.description: Style.Font.DoubleSize, in points; Cell.GetStyle(), then Cell.SetStyle(style).

foregroundColor.description: Style.ForegroundColor: the fill's color, which shows under a Pattern other than None; Cell.GetStyle(), then Cell.SetStyle(style).

backgroundColor.description: Style.BackgroundColor: the color of a pattern's background; Cell.GetStyle(), then Cell.SetStyle(style).

pattern.description: Style.Pattern: the fill's pattern; Solid fills with foregroundColor; Cell.GetStyle(), then Cell.SetStyle(style).

custom.description: Style.Custom: the number format's code, such as #,##0; empty for a built-in format; Cell.GetStyle(), then Cell.SetStyle(style).

number.description: Style.Number: the built-in number format's id; Cell.GetStyle(), then Cell.SetStyle(style).

range.description: A range of a worksheet, made with Cells.CreateRange(area); read does not list ranges, --at reads one. Its value holds every cell of the area: a whole column is 1,048,576 rows, so read a sheet's data at the area its maxDisplayRange gives.

value.description: Range.Value: one list per row, one value per column, a date as its serial number; set, the value has the range's numbers of rows and columns.

name.description: A defined name: a workbook-level name, or a worksheet-level one, whose full text starts with its sheet's name.

printArea.description: PageSetup.PrintArea, such as A1:F20; null without one.

protection.description: What a worksheet's protection allows; the protect_sheet and unprotect_sheet actions protect it.

row.description: A row of a worksheet. Every row of the grid can be addressed; read lists the rows the engine holds.

groupLevel.description: Row.GroupLevel; the group_rows and ungroup_rows actions change it.

column.description: A column of a worksheet. Every column of the grid can be addressed; read lists the columns the engine holds.

width.description: Column.Width, in characters of the workbook's default font.

groupLevel.description: Column.GroupLevel; the group_columns and ungroup_columns actions change it.

merge.description: A merged area of a worksheet, one of Cells.GetMergedAreas(); its address is its area.

validation.description: A data validation of a worksheet.

formula1.description: Validation.Formula1, such as =$A$1:$A$9 or East,West for a list.

areas.description: Validation.Areas, each as A1 writes it.

conditionalFormatting.description: A conditional formatting of a worksheet: its areas and its rules.

areas.description: FormatConditionCollection.GetCellArea(i) for each of its RangeCount areas, as A1 writes it.

rule.description: A rule of a conditional formatting.

style.font.isBold.description: FormatCondition.Style.Font.IsBold; set on the Style, which is then set back.

style.font.isItalic.description: FormatCondition.Style.Font.IsItalic; set on the Style, which is then set back.

style.font.isStrikeout.description: FormatCondition.Style.Font.IsStrikeout; set on the Style, which is then set back.

style.font.underline.description: FormatCondition.Style.Font.Underline; set on the Style, which is then set back.

style.font.color.description: FormatCondition.Style.Font.Color; set on the Style, which is then set back.

style.foregroundColor.description: FormatCondition.Style.ForegroundColor; set on the Style, which is then set back.

style.backgroundColor.description: FormatCondition.Style.BackgroundColor; set on the Style, which is then set back.

style.pattern.description: FormatCondition.Style.Pattern; set on the Style, which is then set back.

style.custom.description: FormatCondition.Style.Custom; set on the Style, which is then set back.

area.description: ListObject.StartRow, StartColumn, EndRow and EndColumn, as A1 writes the area; the resize_table action changes it.

upperLeftCell.description: Picture.UpperLeftRow and UpperLeftColumn, as A1 writes the cell.

sparklineGroup.description: A group of sparklines of a worksheet.

sparklines.description: SparklineGroup.Sparklines: each sparkline's cell, as A1 writes it, and its DataRange, written cell=dataRange.

anchor.description: Chart.ChartObject.UpperLeftRow, UpperLeftColumn, LowerRightRow and LowerRightColumn, as A1 writes the area.

valueAxis.minValue.description: Chart.ValueAxis.MinValue; null where the engine gives none.

name.description: Series.Name, a text or a reference such as =Sales!$A$2.

point.description: A data point of a series.

pivot.description: A pivot table of a worksheet.

tableRange1.description: PivotTable.TableRange1, as A1 writes the area.

dataField.description: A value field of a pivot table; the add_pivot_field action adds one.

add.sheet.description: Adds a sheet to a workbook: WorksheetCollection.Insert(int index, SheetType sheetType, string sheetName)

index.description: The new sheet's position, the engine's, from 0.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new sheet to set after the call, as #/$defs/sheet lists them.

add.name.description: Adds a name to a workbook: NameCollection.Add(string text); the text is the name, or the sheet's name, !, and the name for a worksheet-level one

text.description: The name's text, such as Total or Sales!Local.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new name to set after the call, as #/$defs/name lists them.

add.merge.description: Adds a merge to a sheet: Cells.Merge(int firstRow, int firstColumn, int totalRows, int totalColumns), with the area's first row and column and its numbers of rows and columns

in.description: The address of the sheet to add to.

area.description: The area to merge, such as A1:C1.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new merge to set after the call, as #/$defs/merge lists them.

add.comment.description: Adds a comment to a sheet: CommentCollection.Add(string cellName); on a cell that has a comment the engine returns that comment

in.description: The address of the sheet to add to.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new comment to set after the call, as #/$defs/comment lists them.

add.hyperlink.description: Adds a hyperlink to a sheet: HyperlinkCollection.Add(string cellName, int totalRows, int totalColumns, string address)

in.description: The address of the sheet to add to.

cellName.description: The area's top left cell, such as B2.

totalRows.description: How many rows the area has.

totalColumns.description: How many columns the area has.

address.description: The address the link opens, such as https://example.com or Sheet2!A1.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new hyperlink to set after the call, as #/$defs/hyperlink lists them.

add.validation.description: Adds a validation to a sheet: ValidationCollection.Add(CellArea ca)

in.description: The address of the sheet to add to.

area.description: The area it validates, such as A2:A20.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new validation to set after the call, as #/$defs/validation lists them.

add.conditionalFormatting.description: Adds a conditionalFormatting to a sheet: ConditionalFormattingCollection.Add(): a conditional formatting with no area and no rule; add_conditional_format_area gives it an area

in.description: The address of the sheet to add to.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new conditionalFormatting to set after the call, as #/$defs/conditionalFormatting lists them.

add.rule.description: Adds a rule to a conditionalFormatting: FormatConditionCollection.AddCondition(FormatConditionType type), or AddCondition(type, OperatorType operatorType, string formula1, string formula2) when operatorType is given

in.description: The address of the conditionalFormatting to add to.

operatorType.description: The engine's OperatorType; with it the four-parameter overload is called.

formula1.description: With operatorType: the first formula, such as =100; null when not given.

formula2.description: With operatorType: the second formula, for Between and NotBetween; null when not given.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new rule to set after the call, as #/$defs/rule lists them.

add.table.description: Adds a table to a sheet: ListObjectCollection.Add(string startCell, string endCell, bool hasHeaders)

in.description: The address of the sheet to add to.

startCell.description: The table's top left cell, such as A1.

endCell.description: The table's bottom right cell, such as F20.

hasHeaders.description: Whether the first row is the header row.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new table to set after the call, as #/$defs/table lists them.

add.picture.description: Adds a picture to a sheet: PictureCollection.Add(int upperLeftRow, int upperLeftColumn, Stream stream), with the cell's row and column

in.description: The address of the sheet to add to.

upperLeftCell.description: The cell the picture's top left corner is in, such as H2.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new picture to set after the call, as #/$defs/picture lists them.

add.sparklineGroup.description: Adds a sparklineGroup to a sheet: SparklineGroupCollection.Add(SparklineType type, string dataRange, bool isVertical, CellArea locationRange)

in.description: The address of the sheet to add to.

isVertical.description: Whether each sparkline takes a column of the data rather than a row.

locationRange.description: The cells the sparklines are drawn in, such as F2:F5.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new sparklineGroup to set after the call, as #/$defs/sparklineGroup lists them.

add.chart.description: Adds a chart to a sheet: ChartCollection.Add(ChartType type, int upperLeftRow, int upperLeftColumn, int lowerRightRow, int lowerRightColumn), with the area's corners

in.description: The address of the sheet to add to.

area.description: The cells the chart covers, such as H2:O18.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new chart to set after the call, as #/$defs/chart lists them.

add.series.description: Adds a series to a chart: SeriesCollection.Add(string area, bool isVertical): one call adds one series for each column of the area (isVertical true) or each row (false), and the address the edit reports is the first of them

in.description: The address of the chart to add to.

isVertical.description: Whether each series is a column of the area rather than a row.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new series to set after the call, as #/$defs/series lists them.

add.pivot.description: Adds a pivot to a sheet: PivotTableCollection.Add(string sourceData, string destCellName, string tableName); the add_pivot_field action adds its fields and calculate_pivot fills its cells

in.description: The address of the sheet to add to.

destCellName.description: The pivot table's top left cell, such as H2.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new pivot to set after the call, as #/$defs/pivot lists them.

do.replace.description: Workbook.Replace(string placeHolder, string newValue, ReplaceOptions options), with new ReplaceOptions() and the options given set on it: replaces in the cells of every sheet, values and the strings in formulas. Returns how many cells it changed.

newValue.description: The text to put in its place.

regexKey.description: ReplaceOptions.RegexKey: whether placeHolder is a regular expression.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.protect_workbook.description: Workbook.Protect(ProtectionType protectionType, string password). Returns the workbook's address.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the password.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.unprotect_workbook.description: Workbook.Unprotect(string password), with null when passwordEnv is not given. Returns the workbook's address.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the password.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.insert_rows.description: Cells.InsertRows(int rowIndex, int totalRows, InsertOptions options), with new InsertOptions() and updateReference set on it when given, the row's index from its number. Returns the sheet's address.

row.description: The row the new rows are inserted before, its number as A1 writes it.

updateReference.description: UpdateReference of the options: whether references to the moved cells are updated.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.delete_rows.description: Cells.DeleteRows(int rowIndex, int totalRows, DeleteOptions options), with new DeleteOptions() and updateReference set on it when given. Returns what the engine returns, and the sheet's address.

row.description: The first row deleted, its number as A1 writes it.

updateReference.description: UpdateReference of the options: whether references to the moved cells are updated.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.insert_columns.description: Cells.InsertColumns(int columnIndex, int totalColumns, InsertOptions options), with new InsertOptions() and updateReference set on it when given. Returns the sheet's address.

column.description: The column the new columns are inserted before, its letters as A1 writes them.

updateReference.description: UpdateReference of the options: whether references to the moved cells are updated.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.delete_columns.description: Cells.DeleteColumns(int columnIndex, int totalColumns, DeleteOptions options), with new DeleteOptions() and updateReference set on it when given. Returns the sheet's address.

column.description: The first column deleted, its letters as A1 writes them.

updateReference.description: UpdateReference of the options: whether references to the moved cells are updated.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.autofit_rows.description: Worksheet.AutoFitRows(int startRow, int endRow), the rows' indexes from their numbers. Returns the sheet's address.

startRow.description: The first row, its number as A1 writes it.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.autofit_columns.description: Worksheet.AutoFitColumns(int firstColumn, int lastColumn), the columns' indexes from their letters. Returns the sheet's address.

firstColumn.description: The first column, its letters as A1 writes them.
